name: mirrorps/symfony-taler
description: Symfony bundle for GNU Taler payment integration via mirrorps/taler-php

suggest.symfony/http-client: Recommended for Symfony apps; enable framework.http_client to auto-wire psr18.http_client.
suggest.nyholm/psr7: PSR-17 factories required by Symfony Psr18Client (often installed with symfony/http-client recipes).
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Alternative HTTP client; install with php-http/guzzle7-adapter for PSR-18 discovery.
suggest.symfony/monolog-bundle: Recommended when you want log output: registers a dedicated taler Monolog channel and wires monolog.logger.taler automatically.
suggest.psr/log-implementation: Any PSR-3 logger (e.g. monolog/monolog) if you use a custom logger service instead of MonologBundle.
